privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how Destination Paradise handles the details you share when you browse the site, ask about trips, use the AI planner, book experiences, or contact our team.

sections.title: Information We Collect
items: Contact details such as your name, email address, phone number, WhatsApp contact, and country.
Trip details such as preferred dates, group size, budget, interests, hotel or pickup location, and special requests.
Messages you send through our forms, WhatsApp, email, or social channels.
Planner chat history and handoff details when you use the AI trip planner or ask us to send a draft to the team.
Basic technical information such as browser type, device information, pages visited, language choice, cookie choice, and approximate location from analytics tools when you consent.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
items: To respond to enquiries and prepare trip suggestions, quotes, bookings, and itineraries.
To coordinate guides, drivers, accommodation partners, boat operators, safari providers, and other suppliers needed for your trip.
To run the AI planner, remember your draft locally, and email the team when you choose to hand off a plan.
To improve our website, customer service, packages, excursions, and safari planning experience.
To send booking updates, service messages, and follow-up information connected to your request.

sections.title: Service Providers And Data Sharing
items: Netlify hosts the website and Netlify Functions that receive contact, booking, planner, and newsletter submissions.
Resend sends team notification emails and guest confirmation emails from the contact, booking, and planner workflows.
Anthropic powers the AI trip planner when you chat with it. Planner prompts and recent chat history are sent to Anthropic only for that feature.
Google Analytics measures page visits only after you accept analytics cookies. Google may set _ga cookies for measurement.
Sentry collects technical error reports so we can diagnose broken pages and failed functions.
Open-Meteo, CARTO map tiles, and open.er-api.com provide weather, map, and currency-rate data used by public site features.

We share only the details needed to arrange your trip with trusted local guides, drivers, accommodation partners, boat operators, safari providers, payment providers, or official authorities when required.
We may share information when required by law, safety requirements, border rules, or official travel procedures.
We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Storage, Retention, And Security
items: We keep enquiries and booking details only as long as needed to reply, arrange the trip, handle accounting or legal duties, and improve service quality.
Local browser storage may hold your language, theme, cookie choice, currency-rate cache, and planner history so the site works smoothly.
We use reasonable technical safeguards such as HTTPS, provider access controls, request size limits, validation, rate limiting, and error monitoring.
No website or email system is perfectly secure, so avoid sending passport scans, payment card details, or highly sensitive health information through open text fields.

sections.title: Your Choices
items: You can ask us to correct, update, or delete your personal details when we no longer need them for booking, accounting, safety, or legal reasons.
You can choose not to provide optional details, although this may limit how accurately we can plan your trip.
You can reopen Cookie settings in the footer at any time to withdraw analytics consent. When analytics is turned off, we disable Google Analytics and remove its analytics cookies from this browser.
You can clear local browser storage such as planner history, language, theme, and cached currency rates in your browser settings.
You can unsubscribe from marketing messages at any time by contacting us.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms describe how enquiries, bookings, payments, changes, and travel responsibilities work when you use Destination Paradise services.

sections.title: Using Our Website
items: The website helps you explore Zanzibar and Tanzania trips, request quotes, and contact our team.
Content, prices, routes, availability, and inclusions may change as suppliers, seasons, park rules, fuel costs, and weather conditions change.
You agree not to misuse the website, submit false requests, or interfere with normal site operation.

sections.title: Bookings, Payment, And Cancellation
items: Deposits, payment deadlines, cancellation charges, amendments, refunds, and our responsibilities to you are set out in full in our Booking Policy, which forms part of these terms.
You are responsible for checking names, dates, pickup details, passport information, dietary needs, medical considerations, and travel documents before confirmation.
Your quote or checkout summary will confirm what is included, what is excluded, and any supplier conditions specific to your trip.

sections.title: Travel Responsibility
items: Travel always carries some risk. You are responsible for suitable travel insurance, health advice, visas, passports, and personal belongings.
We work carefully with local partners, but we are not responsible for delays or losses caused by events outside our reasonable control.
If something goes wrong during your trip, contact us quickly so we can help while there is still time to act.

booking.title: Booking Policy
booking.intro: These booking policies apply to every tour, excursion, transfer, safari, and package arranged by Destination Paradise LTD, whether you book by enquiry or instantly through our online store.

sections.title: Booking Confirmation
items: All bookings are subject to availability at the time we confirm them.
For bookings arranged by enquiry, a booking is confirmed only once we have received the required deposit or payment and sent you written confirmation.

Experiences booked instantly through our online store are confirmed automatically as soon as our payment partner verifies your payment and we issue your booking codes. No separate written confirmation is needed.
If a store payment cannot be verified automatically, we review it manually and contact you before the booking is either confirmed or released.

Prices are quoted in US dollars unless otherwise stated. Enquiry bookings may also be settled in Tanzanian shillings at the prevailing exchange rate. Online store payments are charged in US dollars, and prices displayed in other currencies are indicative estimates.

sections.title: Payment
items: Day tours, excursions, and transfers in Zanzibar: full payment is required before the service begins. Experiences booked in our online store are paid in full at checkout.
Tanzania safaris: a 30% deposit confirms your booking, and the remaining 70% is due at least 30 days before the safari start date.
Safari bookings made within 30 days of the start date require full payment on confirmation.

If a safari balance is not received by its due date we will contact you before taking any action. Where the balance remains unpaid, we may treat the booking as cancelled by you and the charges below will apply.

sections.title: How We Calculate Deadlines
items: Deadlines are counted back from the scheduled start of the service: the pickup time shown on your confirmation for tours and transfers, or the start date for safaris.
All times are East Africa Time (UTC+3), the local time in Zanzibar and mainland Tanzania.
Periods described in days mean calendar days, including weekends and public holidays.
A cancellation takes effect when we receive it in writing, not when it was sent.

sections.title: Cancellation By You
items: Cancellations must be sent to us in writing by email or WhatsApp. The charge depends on when we receive your cancellation.
A no-show without notice, or leaving a trip early once it has started, is charged at 100% and no refund is due.

Less than 24 hours before the start, or no-show

tables.caption: Tanzania safaris
rows: 14 days or less, no-show, or early departure

sections.title: Cancellation Or Changes By Us
items: We may need to cancel or change a trip if a minimum number of guests is not reached, a supplier withdraws, a vessel or vehicle becomes unavailable, or conditions make the trip unsafe.
Where we cancel, you may choose a full refund of everything paid for the cancelled service, or an alternative date or comparable experience of equal value.
Where we make a significant change to a confirmed booking before departure, you may accept the change, move to an alternative we offer, or cancel that service for a full refund.

Weather, sea conditions, tides, park access, road conditions, and official instructions may require us to adjust timing, routing, the order of activities, or the supplier used. Where the experience is still delivered in substance, these adjustments are not treated as a cancellation.

sections.title: Amendments
items: Changes to travel dates, accommodation, or itinerary are subject to availability at the time you ask.
Where a supplier charges an amendment fee, or the new arrangements cost more, the difference is payable by you.
Amendments requested close to travel may not be possible. In that case the cancellation charges above apply if you choose not to travel.

sections.title: Children
items: Children are welcome on all tours and safaris.
Child rates, and the age bands they apply to, are set by each hotel, park, and activity provider and are confirmed in your quote or at checkout. They are not standard across suppliers.
Some activities carry minimum ages or health restrictions set by the operator for safety reasons. We will tell you where these apply.
A parent or guardian must accompany and supervise children throughout the trip.

sections.title: Park Fees And Government Taxes
items: National park fees, government taxes, and conservation fees are included only where your quotation or booking confirmation says so.

These fees are set by the Tanzanian authorities and can change at short notice. Where an increase is announced after your booking is confirmed, we will tell you the amount and the effective date before charging it.
Where a government-imposed increase materially raises the total price of your confirmed booking, you may cancel the affected service without charge.

sections.title: Travel Documents
items: You are responsible for holding a valid passport, any visa required for Tanzania, and any vaccinations or health certificates required for entry.
Check the current requirements for your nationality with the relevant embassy before you travel, as rules change.
We cannot refund a booking missed because required travel documents were not in order.

sections.title: Travel Insurance
items: We strongly recommend comprehensive travel insurance covering medical treatment, emergency evacuation, cancellation and curtailment, and personal belongings.
Cover for emergency evacuation matters particularly on safari and on marine excursions, where distances to medical facilities are long.
Arranging travel insurance is your responsibility. We do not provide it.

sections.title: Health And Safety
items: Tell us about any medical condition, allergy, mobility limitation, pregnancy, or dietary requirement before travel so we can check what is suitable and inform suppliers.
Follow the safety instructions given by your guide, driver, skipper, or park ranger at all times.

Activities such as snorkelling, diving, boat trips, swimming, and walking safaris carry inherent risks that cannot be removed. Where you choose to take part you accept those risks — this does not limit our responsibility for our own negligence.
A guide or operator may refuse or stop participation where they judge it unsafe. No refund is due where this follows from a condition that was not disclosed to us.

sections.title: Force Majeure
items: We are not liable for delays, cancellations, or changes caused by events beyond our reasonable control, including severe weather, natural disasters, epidemics and pandemics, strikes, civil unrest, government action, border closures, or airspace restrictions.
Where such an event prevents a trip from going ahead, we will refund what we are able to recover from suppliers and will offer an alternative date where one is possible.
We will tell you promptly what has happened and what your options are.

sections.title: Our Responsibility To You
items: We arrange trips as an agent for hotels, airlines, transport providers, boat operators, park authorities, and activity operators, who provide those services under their own terms.
We are responsible for arranging your booking with reasonable care and skill, and for the acts and omissions of our own staff.
We are not responsible for loss, damage, delay, or expense caused by a third-party supplier's own act or omission, or by anything outside our reasonable control.

Nothing in these policies excludes or limits our liability for death or personal injury caused by our negligence, for fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, or for any other liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.
Where our liability is not excluded, it is limited to the total amount you paid us for the affected booking.

sections.title: Refunds
items: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method wherever possible, normally within 14 days of us confirming the refund.
Where you cancel inside a charging window, we refund the balance after the applicable cancellation charge and any non-refundable supplier costs already committed to your booking.
Where a refund is due in full — because we cancelled, or because you cancelled free of charge within the permitted window — we do not deduct payment processing fees.
Bank transfer charges may be deducted only where a refund has to be sent by international bank transfer at your request, rather than to the original payment method.
Refunds of online store bookings are returned through our payment partner to the card or mobile-money account used at checkout.

sections.title: Special Requests
items: Requests such as dietary requirements, honeymoon arrangements, room preferences, adjoining rooms, or specific vehicle seating are passed to suppliers but cannot be guaranteed.
A special request is confirmed only where your booking confirmation says it is confirmed.

sections.title: Complaints
items: If something is wrong during your trip, tell your guide, driver, or our office immediately so we can try to put it right while you are still with us. Most problems can be solved on the spot.
If a problem cannot be resolved locally, write to us within 28 days of your return with your booking reference and what happened.
We acknowledge complaints within 5 working days and aim to give a full response within 28 days.

sections.title: Governing Law
items: These policies and your booking are governed by the laws of the United Republic of Tanzania, and the Tanzanian courts have jurisdiction.
If you are a consumer resident elsewhere, this does not remove the protection of any mandatory consumer laws of your country of residence.

sections.title: Acceptance And Updates
items: Paying a deposit or the full amount, or completing checkout in our online store, confirms that you have read, understood, and accepted these booking policies.
We may update these policies where supplier terms, park regulations, or legal requirements change.
The version that applies to your trip is the one published when your booking was confirmed. Later changes do not apply retrospectively to a confirmed booking.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.intro: This policy explains the cookies, local storage, and similar technologies used by Destination Paradise.

sections.title: Essential Storage
items: dp_cookie_consent_v1 stores your cookie choice so we know whether analytics is allowed.
dp_tweaks stores theme and display preferences such as light or dark mode.
dp_lang stores your language choice, and dp_fx_rates may cache currency rates for price display.
plannerHistory stores your AI planner chat in your browser so you can continue a plan later.

sections.title: Analytics Cookies
items: Google Analytics loads only after you accept analytics in the cookie banner or Cookie settings.
Analytics helps us understand which pages are useful, where visitors find us, and where trip planning can improve.
Google Analytics may set _ga and related cookies. If you later turn analytics off, the site disables analytics and attempts to delete those cookies from this browser.

sections.title: Third-Party Requests
items: Sentry may receive technical error data when a page or function fails.
Open-Meteo, CARTO map tiles, and open.er-api.com may receive basic request data when weather, maps, or currency rates load.
Resend and Anthropic receive data only when you submit a form, booking request, or AI planner message that uses those services.

sections.title: Managing Your Choice
items: You can reopen Cookie settings from the footer at any time and switch analytics on or off.
You can also block, delete, or limit cookies and local storage in your browser settings.
Some features may not work as expected if essential local storage is disabled.

sections.title: Updates
items: We may update this policy when our website tools, analytics setup, or booking workflows change.
The latest version will be posted on this page with the updated date.
